title: MOND (modified gravity instead of dark matter)
example_questions: What if dark matter does not exist?
Why do galaxies spin so fast?
summary: Modified Newtonian Dynamics proposes that gravity strengthens at very low accelerations, explaining flat galaxy rotation curves without dark matter. It predicts galaxy scale regularities remarkably well but struggles with galaxy clusters and the cosmic microwave background, where dark matter works better.
support_note: Dark matter is the consensus; MOND is a persistent minority alternative.
what_happens: At high accelerations gravity is Newtonian
Below about 1.2e-10 m/s^2 it falls off more slowly
Outer stars orbit faster than visible mass alone would allow
equations: deep MOND: a = sqrt(G M a0) / r
objections: Galaxy clusters such as the Bullet Cluster

sources.title: A modification of the Newtonian dynamics as a possible alternative to the hidden mass hypothesis
